section.heading: Exemption from tax on corporations, certain trusts, etc.

subsection.heading: List of exempt organizations
subsection.chapeau: The following organizations are referred to in subsection (a):

subparagraph.content: Benevolent life insurance associations of a purely local character, mutual ditch or irrigation companies, mutual or cooperative telephone companies, or like organizations; but only if 85 percent or more of the income consists of amounts collected from members for the sole purpose of meeting losses and expenses.
